evidence_delta: (1) PR #1166 is open/unmerged and policy-bound because it switches production roles to Claude, contrary to the current founder direction. (2) Current dev already preserves the useful single-switch/materialization mechanics: committed executor_config.json is Codex/Codex, role-only/missing config materializes backends and bridge reviewers from role_agents, and set_roles keeps committed and fallback paths in sync. (3) The remaining drift is the last-resort static DEFAULT_EXECUTOR_CONFIG literal: if the committed config is truly absent/unreadable, implementer/reviewer and phase backends still fall back to Claude. This wave changes only that last-resort literal to Codex/Codex and locks it with focused tests.

progress_proof_after: The committed config and the last-resort DEFAULT_EXECUTOR_CONFIG both select Codex/Codex for implementer/reviewer, derived implementer backends, reviewer backends, and bridge reviewers; explicit overrides and set_roles polymorphism continue to work.
